description_en: Installs a plugin for a specified AgentCore workspace. Currently supports the collaboration plugin. The installation process is executed asynchronously
description_zh: 为指定的 AgentCore 工作空间安装插件。当前支持 collaboration 插件，安装过程异步执行
kebab_example: aliyun agentcore install-workspace-plugin --workspace-id ws-123456 --plugin-name collaboration --region cn-hangzhou
name: InstallWorkspacePlugin

parameters.help_en: The plugin name. Currently, only collaboration is supported
parameters.help_zh: 插件名称。当前仅支持 collaboration
parameters.name: plugin_name

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable public network access. If set to true without a VPC specified, PUB_NET is used. If set to true with a VPC specified, PRIVATE_PUBNET is used. If only a VPC is specified, PRIVATE_NET is used. At least one of public network or VPC must be configured
fields.help_zh: 设置为 true 且未指定 VPC 时使用 PUB_NET；设置为 true 且指定 VPC 时使用 PRIVATE_PUBNET；仅指定 VPC 时使用 PRIVATE_NET。公网和 VPC 至少配置一种
fields.name: enabled

fields.help_en: Controls whether the collaboration component is allowed to access the public network. This configuration only controls public network access capability and does not expose the component service to the public network
fields.help_zh: 控制协作组件是否允许访问公网。该配置只控制公网访问能力，不表示将组件服务暴露到公网
fields.name: internet

fields.help_en: Specifies whether the collaboration plugin uses VPC networking. If set to false, vpcId and vSwitchIds are ignored. If set to true, you must provide both vpcId and at least two vSwitchIds
fields.help_zh: 显式控制 collaboration 插件是否使用 VPC 网络。设置为 false 时，vpcId 和 vSwitchIds 将被忽略；设置为 true 时必须同时提供 vpcId 和至少两个 vSwitchIds
fields.name: enabled

fields.help_en: The list of vSwitch IDs. The collaboration plugin requires that the vSwitches cover at least two different zones, and all vSwitches must belong to the VPC specified by vpcId
fields.help_zh: 交换机 ID 列表。collaboration 插件要求交换机至少覆盖两个不同可用区，且所有交换机必须属于 vpcId 指定的 VPC
fields.name: vswitchids

fields.help_en: The user VPC and vSwitch list used for deploying the collaboration plugin. The zones corresponding to the vSwitches are queried by the server and do not need to be provided by the user
fields.help_zh: 协作插件部署使用的用户 VPC 和交换机列表。交换机对应的可用区由服务端查询，不需要用户传入 Zones
fields.name: vpc

fields.help_en: The network configuration used by the collaboration plugin. If not specified, the server uses the existing network configuration of the workspace
fields.help_zh: collaboration 插件使用的网络配置。未指定时，服务端使用工作空间已有的网络配置
fields.name: network

fields.help_en: The plugin-specific configuration. The configuration structure is determined by pluginName. Currently, the collaboration plugin supports network
fields.help_zh: 插件专属配置。配置结构由 pluginName 决定。当前 collaboration 插件支持 network
fields.name: config

parameters.help_en: The request body for installing a plugin
parameters.name: body

schema.description_en: The response for installing a workspace plugin
schema.description_zh: 安装工作空间插件响应

data.description_en: The details of the plugin installation operation

enabled.description_en: Indicates whether the plugin is enabled

status.description_en: The plugin status. Valid values: DISABLED, ENABLING, ENABLED, ENABLE_FAILED, DISABLING, and DISABLE_FAILED
status.title_en: 插件状态。DISABLED 表示未安装，ENABLING 表示安装中，ENABLED 表示安装完成，ENABLE_FAILED 表示安装失败。
status.title_zh: 插件状态。DISABLED 表示未安装，ENABLING 表示安装中，ENABLED 表示安装完成，ENABLE_FAILED 表示安装失败。

message.description_en: The response message. An error description is returned if the request fails
message.description_zh: 响应消息。请求失败时返回错误描述

success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful

schema.title_en: 安装工作空间插件响应
schema.title_zh: 安装工作空间插件响应
